svg.title: Gestion des projets — deployment on Kubernetes
svg.desc: Deployment diagram: in the gestion-projets namespace a NodePort Service exposes two nginx frontend pods, which proxy /api/ to the backend ClusterIP Service and its two Spring Boot pods; those connect as the application user to MySQL, a one-replica StatefulSet behind a headless Service, whose data lives on a claim from its volume template. Kustomize generates the ConfigMap and the Secret; the kubelet pulls the images from Docker Hub.
